name: Storybook Princesses
description: Six princesses, six different moments, one illustrated look. Each line of the prompt becomes its own image, so one Forge gives you the whole set. Edit or delete lines to change the cast.
prompt_example:
classic animated-film princess with long auburn hair in a green travelling cloak, kneeling in a snowy pine forest to feed a fawn from her hand, soft cel shading, warm rim light, storybook illustration, painterly background
classic animated-film princess with dark braided hair and a yellow ball gown, spinning alone through a candlelit library, motion in the skirt, dust in the light beams, soft cel shading, storybook illustration
classic animated-film princess with black hair and a red sash, fencing on a palace balcony at dawn, sword raised, hair loose, confident grin, soft cel shading, storybook illustration
classic animated-film princess with silver-blonde hair and a blue winter dress, ice-skating on a frozen canal between old houses, arms out, scarf streaming, soft cel shading, storybook illustration
classic animated-film princess with copper curls and a simple linen dress, elbow-deep in flour in a sunlit bakery, laughing, cat on the windowsill, soft cel shading, storybook illustration
